capabilities: Extract contract terms from PDF credit agreements
Reconcile CSV payment records against contract figures
Generate AI risk and penalty analysis reports
Route contract, payment, and report files into a fixed vault structure
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README lists an unreviewed badge. Requires structuring the vault with fixed folders (01_Contracts/, 02_Payments/, Analysis/); payment reconciliation can be skipped for PDFs-only audits.
motivation: The README says it targets strict financial confidentiality, so the author built it to keep contract text and financial data fully local.
problem: Auditing financial contracts and payment ledgers requires manual PDF reading and cross-referencing, which Obsidian does not do and generic AI tools send data to the cloud.
summary: Finance audit tool that extracts terms from credit-agreement PDFs, reconciles CSV payment records, and generates AI risk reports using local Ollama models.
